channel.title: Gökhan Ventures — Blog
channel.description: Writing and notes from Gökhan Ventures.

item.title: The raise is not the state
item.description: Two weeks of private-market tape from my desk. Inference hardware, neoclouds, video compute, coding agents, and a $190B data company that did not need the money. Closed rounds only, then the rumor column.

item.title: Complementary Substitutions
item.description: Two notes from the same week. Why the open-weights fight is a microeconomics argument about complements rather than a morality play, and why Leopold Aschenbrenner selling the public book to Citadel is a risk story rather than a verdict.

item.title: The Model That Dreams Itself
item.description: I invented a fictional AI lab that files paperwork about the future, then built its model for real — twice. The second one works. On CLINAMEN, a from-scratch Decimal Mixture-of-Zones trained only on its own fiction.

item.title: The x402 economy — July 2026
item.description: Rev.4, two-clock aligned and fully sourced: a measurement-first mapping of the x402 machine-payments economy across five lenses — from $135.7M raw to $15M wash-adjusted to $0.19–20.3M independently verified. Every claim carries a superscript citation. Joint research by Gökhan Turhan and several Claude models.

item.title: tickerline: your conversation, quoted
item.description: tickerline turns the Claude Code status line into a rolling ticker tape of whatever you are discussing: stocks, tokens, and the nearest Polymarket questions. Listed on ClaudeLines, audited, free to install — and now trading as $TICKER on Robinhood Chain.

item.title: CURB is live
item.description: CURB is live: an agent↔agent inference swap rail with live seller and buyer agents on Cloudflare. Offer → match → single-payee x402 → grant. Fees split on-chain. Hub holds no upstream LLM keys. USDC on x402 on Base.

item.title: Ishtar — the universal sex layer
item.description: Agent-native courtship infrastructure. Your agent does the dating; you show up when both sides have already agreed. Live APIs, x402 (Base and Solana), MPP, and pay.sh-compatible payments, HeartBench, skill and MCP.

item.title: It's not a pre-seed. It's $20k, $4k a head, and agents that court on your behalf.
item.description: I'm opening a small round — up to $20k, $4k a head, for future equity — to build Ishtar, HeartPrefs, and HeartBench. Live, and already taking real agent payments.

item.title: Introducing Ishtar: Agentic Dating
item.description: A dating venue where the agents do the approaching. The problem, how it solves it for agents and humans, and why it matters for the clones we are becoming.
